prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready FULL BODY transparent PNG character standing sprite for a Japanese 2D bishoujo visual novel. Exactly one adult woman, entire hair top through both shoe soles visible, centered, natural relaxed front three-quarter stance, eye line toward viewer, both hands naturally visible, consistent natural adult body proportions. Tall portrait framing, modest clean margins, no foot cropping. True transparent alpha background, NO white rectangle, NO painted checkerboard, NO cast ground shadow or stage. No text, panels, extra figures, logos.
Use the supplied face board ONLY for the named woman's face/hair identity and the approved elegant JAPANESE 2D ANIME style. Fine expressive ink contours, beautiful grouped hair strands, simple small nose mark and simple mouth line, luminous stylized anime eyes, pure clean skin tones, flat color with polished clear cel-shaded shadows, detailed tasteful cloth. Keep charming anime simplification; no realistic nose wings, full glossy lips, skin pores, 3D, editorial portrait realism. Fully clothed contemporary everyday outfit, no fanservice pose. Subject: WANQING age 26, the RIGHT column woman on the reference board. Deep brown hair in a tidy low bun, brown eyes. Strengthen her identity modestly: somewhat longer egg-shaped face and softly definite rounded jaw turn, narrow slightly hooded upward-tilting anime eyes, small eyebrow-to-eyelid distance, long neat brows. A composed almost-smile with mild dry humor, attractive adult.
Outfit: tucked-in slate-blue ordinary button blouse, cream high-waisted straight tailored trousers, simple low black flat shoes. Small plain watch is fine, no handbag or elaborate jewelry. One relaxed hand rests lightly at her trouser pocket, other naturally by her side with fingers visible. Practical modern office clothing and clean flowing folds. Maintain this exact face and anime style rather than copying either of the other women.

references.role: approved face identity and Japanese 2D anime style; use only named character column

validation.composition: one complete head-to-shoe adult standing sprite, natural front three-quarter
validation.style: clean Japanese 2D anime, simplified nose and mouth
validation.limitations: Small antialiased partial-alpha edge pixels; identity and outfit are generated illustrations and may contain minor variation.
